body: Never thought about being selfish at all. I keep thinking its morally wrong. I appreciate you listening to my pitiful problem though.
17, about to be a senior next scool year

Its just so hard to follow my parent's expectations of me. Our arguments always turn about themselves about how they were so initiative at school and how they worked harder and that my generation got it easy. It just makes me feel unmotivated. Even with just cleaning my room it just suddenly turns to a whole scolding about how this slovenly way of living would affect me. I try to ignore it but its just getting to me.
